title: Uthama Rasa
desc: Meenu, a bubbly girl, is in love with Chinnaiya, the village leader. Things change when Marudhu, who is the son of Chinnaiya's rival, Parama Thevar, falls for Meenu.

title: Thazhuvatha Kaigal
desc: Gopal and Rajeswari live a happy married life with their children. However, things start to change when he finds out that his wife suffers from blood cancer.

title: En Uyir Thozhan
desc: Chittu finds herself abandoned and alone until Dharma steps in to help, but his deep loyalty to politics begins to strain the fragile peace they build.

title: Eeramana Rojave
desc: Shanthi and Siva fall in love in college. However, chaos ensues when a fellow student attempts to break their relationship.

title: Pandi Nattu Thangam
desc: A village chief and his father, who control the village activities besides smuggling sandalwood, create problems for a forest officer, Thangapandian, and a fellow villager, Radha.
